description: Compile-time dependency injection auto-registration for .NET using Roslyn source generators. Add [Scoped], [Singleton], or [Transient] to your classes — AutoWire generates IServiceCollection registration code at build time. Zero runtime overhead, no reflection, no startup cost. Supports keyed services (.NET 8+) and works with ASP.NET Core, Worker Services, MAUI, and any Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection project.
